scene: The boost pad catapults you onto a bustling multi-level transit deck.
picture: Side-scrolling view of a multi-level sky transit hub. On the far left sits a flatbed robotic delivery truck with an open ramp. Left of centre sits the player in her purple wheelchair and teal hoodie. At centre, a cylindrical glass elevator stands open. On the far right waits a polished brass steam locomotive.
shown: a yellow robotic delivery truck parked with its rear door open on far left
a cylindrical glowing glass elevator waiting with open sliding doors at centre
a brass steam train puffing sweet peppermint smoke beside a platform on far right

variants.scene: You arrive at a busy transit deck overlooking the twilight city skyline.
Whistling steam and gentle neon glows greet you on the high platform deck.
Still searching for {quest}, you roll across the busy platform between futuristic tracks.
